description: Task 3 of PR #1617: search for physical observables that exhibit +0.5·h² (the Yekutieli natural-reading H_4 partition quantity) at their h² coefficient. Tests deuteron/⁴He/³He/tritium binding energies, multi-nucleon non-additive residuals, isospin mirror residuals under various natural normalizations.

data.verdict: NULL — none of 5 candidate observables (deuteron/⁴He/³He/T binding, multi-nucleon residuals, isospin mirrors) normalizes to +0.5·h² under 13 natural normalizers. The Yekutieli +0.5 may be a STRUCTURAL quantity without a corresponding L2 observable — common for partition-combinatoric quantities.
